recipes.name: Filet Mignon and Balsamic Strawberries
ingredients_raw: freshly ground black pepper to taste

steps.text: Mix together the strawberries, brown sugar, and balsamic vinegar in a bowl, and allow to sit for 1 to 3 hours, stirring occasionally.
Preheat an oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C).

Heat olive oil in an oven-safe, heavy steel or cast-iron skillet over high heat. Sprinkle the filets with salt and pepper on both sides, gently place in the hot skillet, and sear each side until well-browned, 1 to 2 minutes per side. Slide the skillet into the preheated oven, and cook until they start to become firm and are reddish-pink and juicy in the center, about 10 minutes. An instant-read thermometer inserted into the center should read 130 degrees F (54 degrees C). Transfer the steaks to a platter, and tent with foil to rest.

Pour steak juices from the skillet into a small saucepan. Strain the strawberries and discard the liquid. Add the strawberries to the steak juices, bring the sauce to a simmer over medium-low heat, and melt the butter into the sauce, tilting the pan several times to gently incorporate the butter into the sauce. Serve each fillet topped with about 1/2 cup of strawberries and a sprinkle of freshly ground black pepper.

raw_recipe.headline: Filet Mignon and Balsamic Strawberries
raw_recipe.description: Tender seared beef filets are quickly oven-roasted, then topped with sweet and savory marinated balsamic strawberries for a romantic presentation.

review.reviewBody: I really liked this one. I didn't strain the liquids, bc I like to have a lot of sauce w my steaks. Next time I'll double yhe amnt of strawberries.

This was a delicious alternative to our usual steak. We grilled the steak w some steak seasoning. I did not add any juices to the strawberries but reduced strawberries w vinegar/sugar and drizzled over the steaks with some feta on top. Delicious.

I added red wine to the meat & marinated it in wine, & roasted garlic olive oil sat & pepper. I only added 1/4 cup of red wine & should have looked harder for a really high end cut of tender steak! We used Bison Fillet (tough & chewy) despite being grass fed!! . I also used high end Balsamic & the delicate flavors were scrumptious!!!

Sorry, my review sent before i could finish it. As i said before, the whole family found this recipe to be decadent and delicious. However, I meant to also add to my review that we had a small problem getting enough left over filet juices to constitute a sauce, so in addition to the filet juices we retained some of the balsamic juice that the strawberries were marinated in, and reduced that down to complete the sauce. It was a bit on the sweet side, but as I said before, I'm a lover of sweet sauces when paired with a tender filet.
We cooked the steak on a charcoal grill with a broiler tray. It didn't provide any juice, but the strawberry/steak combo were great without it. Easy and great!

I wasn't sure I'd like this, but it's superb - made it for Valentine Day and again the next day because it was so good. The only thing I changed the second time was using canola oil rather than olive oil in the skillet when it went into the oven. I found that the first time I made it, the olive oil had a tendency to burn at 400 degrees. The second time I made it I used canola oil and it didn't burn. I'm only making 1/2 the recipe because I'm feeding 2 so perhaps that was the difference.

My wife fell and broke two ribs. Even the narcotics Rx didn't eliminate her pain. I made this for her, and saw her smile for the first time in two days. Yes, it's THAT GOOD! She said, "Please, don't lose that recipe".

Love this recipe. I've made it for my wife for the last few Valentine's Days. It has become a tradition. Served with baked potato (sour cream/chives) and Ben&Jerry's chocolate brownie ice cream for dessert.
Great recipe. If you haven't tried it you're missing out
This was amazing! I made it for my husband for Valentine’s Day dinner. I will definitely make this again.
We made this for Valentine’s Day dinner and it was absolutely amazing!! We will save this one for special occasions!!

Made this recipe for my wife for Valentine's Day. I didn't strain the strawberries either so I have a lot of leftover sauce, which went PERFECTLY with the steak. I will definitely make this again on a special occasion!
Great flavor and easy to follow instructions. Taste absolutely wonderful and super tender!!!!
This was just okay to my husband & I. We love a good steak and trying new toppings. This wasn't terrible but also not something we would have again.
